title: My world's
content: I don't think I have a mall. Mine is like a college campus. The buildings are new and seem way larger and more intimidating than the college I went to. I've had many different things happen here. Rarely people from my real life show up here,and every time one has, something bad happens in the dream. Once my nephew was lost on this campus, he's 4. I also have this place I call a hub. It seems like an underground bar. It's dark with like a reddish hue in the air. It has an old style feel to it and I think I just wait at the bar, feels like to meet someone. And I have this factory I worked in only it's very small very different and just uncomfortable. The other one I have, and I didn't even remember until I was reading these posts, seems like a mixture of cedar point and a water park. I can't remember this one very well but I feel like it rains a lot here. I always thought these were just places from my past that I constructed in my dreams. I find it weird that some people have these worlds and some people don't. Also whenever I have them they just feel like something more.
